categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, development, and sales of mid-to-high-end intelligent audio SoC chips. Its main product lines include Bluetooth audio SoC chips, portable audio-video SoC chips, and edge AI processor chips, serving wireless audio, smart wearables, and AIoT smart interaction fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as high-performance audio ADC/DAC, low-latency wireless communication, high integration and low power consumption, advanced audio algorithm processing, and a highly integrated SoC design framework. It employs a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and service providers, while focusing on chip design and software-hardware co-development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international terminal brands in consumer electronics, including brands like Harman, Sony, Xiaomi, Honor, Logitech, and others. The products are widely applied in Bluetooth speakers, wireless home theater systems, smartwatches, wireless microphones, wireless gaming headsets, Bluetooth earphones, and smart home and office devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales both domestically and internationally. It has subsidiaries and offices in Zhuhai, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and Chengdu, with overseas customers and supply chains extending to global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless integrated circuit design enterprise. It focuses on chip design and development, while wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing are outsourced to foundries and subcontractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing low-power, low-latency, high-quality audio SoC technology, integrating AI acceleration engines to build heterogeneous CPU+DSP+NPU architectures for edge AI computing, and expanding product lines in Bluetooth audio, smart wearables, and AIoT. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on Bluetooth 5.4 and LE Audio standards, wireless communication upgrades, and AI-driven audio chip innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of SoC chips and integrated solutions. The company sells chips mainly via a buyout model through distributors and direct sales, supplemented by providing comprehensive software development platforms and integrated hardware-software solutions to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and an important global supplier in the Bluetooth audio SoC market, especially in mid-to-high-end segments. It competes with international and domestic IC design firms by leveraging proprietary technologies and deep integration with top-tier terminal brands, maintaining a strong market position in wireless audio and smart wearable chip sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 520 million, a 25.41% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 65 million, up 21.04%. The company maintains a high R&D investment ratio (~31.8% of revenue) and has shown steady growth driven by expanding product adoption and market demand recovery in consumer electronics.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, low-power, and low-latency audio SoC solutions with superior audio fidelity and integrated AI capabilities. Its proprietary technologies in audio ADC/DAC, wireless communication, and AI acceleration provide differentiated performance, enabling premium user experiences in wireless audio and smart wearable devices. The company also offers customized, integrated hardware-software solutions to reduce customer development costs and accelerate time-to-market.
